description: This class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for creating a ride request, encapsulating user ID, pickup and drop locations, and their respective latitude and longitude coordinates.

classes.name: RideCreateRequest
classes.description: A DTO for encapsulating data needed to create a ride, including user ID, locations, and coordinates.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the ride request.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID for the ride request.

methods.name: getPickupLat
methods.description: Returns the latitude of the pickup location.

methods.name: setPickupLat
methods.description: Sets the latitude of the pickup location.

methods.name: getPickupLng
methods.description: Returns the longitude of the pickup location.

methods.name: setPickupLng
methods.description: Sets the longitude of the pickup location.

methods.name: getDropLat
methods.description: Returns the latitude of the drop location.

methods.name: setDropLat
methods.description: Sets the latitude of the drop location.

methods.name: getDropLng
methods.description: Returns the longitude of the drop location.

methods.name: setDropLng
methods.description: Sets the longitude of the drop location.
